summary: Feed s121_double is degraded: 27.7% duplicate packets and 100% missing VLAN tags (required VLANs 10, 20 not seen). NDR receives untagged duplicates, wasting capacity and losing VLAN-aware detection coverage.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding the same packets twice without deduplication - typical when aggregating SPANs/TAPs from both sides of a link or aggregating two SPAN sessions covering same traffic and sending to one NDR port. 646 of 2333 packets (27.7%) exceed 5% threshold.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR wastes CPU/storage on duplicates, skews flow counts and TCP reassembly, inflates alerts and can cause missed detections due to processing overhead despite needing full payload and both directions.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet broker deduplication to drop identical packets within dedup window before delivery to NDR, restoring correct traffic counts without losing coverage.

findings.root_cause: VLAN tags are being stripped upstream - SPAN configured with 'vlan stripping' or packet broker set to strip 802.1Q on ingress/egress. 100% of packets are untagged so required VLANs 10 and 20 are invisible to tool.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR requires VLANs 10, 20 for segmentation and detection coverage; without tags it cannot apply VLAN-aware policies, correlate lateral movement, or detect VLAN-hopping/mis-segmentation.

recommended_fix.why: Configure TAP/SPAN and packet broker to preserve and forward 802.1Q tags for VLANs 10,20 to the NDR so it regains VLAN visibility.
